parent_objective: design source-diverse extreme/fault scenario generation after M1230 partial-positive source collapse
blocked_by: M1230 accepted rows are short-horizon and source-collapsed
supersedes: continuing to tune the same M1226 public source pool
invalidates: training directly from M1230 accepted rows

public_gates: M1232 may design source-generation infrastructure only
M1232 must preserve actor input contract
M1232 must not use private holdout
M1232 must keep hidden fault labels out of deployable actor inputs
M1232 must select a bounded first implementation step
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add fault labels or hidden parameters to actor inputs
do not treat fault scenario labels as oracle feasibility labels
do not claim self-identification from scenario design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens a new source-generation branch to create source-diverse hidden-dynamics stress cases instead of overfitting the M1226 public source pool
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if scenario families require oracle actor inputs
stop if first implementation step is too broad to validate
stop if source-diversity gates are not defined
fallback_plan: narrow to one or two hidden fault families first
use existing friction/actuator randomization hooks if full fault dynamics are not yet implemented
route to simulator extension only after design identifies missing dynamics hooks
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1231 pivots away from a source-collapsed public pool

admission_evidence: M1230 produced a local materialization signal but failed source-diversity gates
user explicitly wants broad extreme/fault scenario coverage for a general evasive driver
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: first bounded implementation step is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1232 is source-generation design and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design future source cases where hidden dynamics should require history
do not claim self-ID from scenario labels
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Self-ID evidence remains blocked until future source-diverse matched-history outcome gates pass.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If fault-source design cannot avoid oracle actor inputs, narrow the branch or fall back to deployable randomization hooks.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A source-generation branch focused on hidden extreme/fault dynamics is higher leverage than continued grid tuning around M1230's source-collapsed short-horizon active set.
success_criteria: scenario families and hidden ranges are specified
first bounded implementation step is selected
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: fault labels are added to actor inputs
scenario design becomes too broad to validate
decision_rule: M1232 passes if it defines a bounded source-generation branch with actor-input guardrails and a concrete first implementation step.
